stem: In diagnostic testing, what does pre-test probability mean?

options.text: The chance of disease after a positive test
The chance of a negative test in someone without disease
The ratio of sensitivity to specificity
The estimated probability of disease before the test result is known
The chance of a positive test in someone with disease

explanation: Pre-test probability is the estimated likelihood that a patient has the condition before the test result is available. It influences how predictive a positive or negative result will be.
